about: URL-to-answer pairs both keys.py and keys.mjs must reproduce exactly (test_keys.py, test_keys.mjs). Add a case by appending {method, url, note} and running python web/public/keys.py --fixtures, then read the diff: an expect that changed for an old case is a contract change. '{tag}' stands for the family's tag, which comes from the manifest at run time.
